method: Unchanged original classes on the MobMoveProbe/ChickenProbe world double, which supplies one chunk (inhabited time), WorldInfo (world time, game rules), uniform light, a floor below y 0 and a particle log. local: World.func_147462_b. spider: EntitySpider.onSpawnWithEgg(null) with seeded World.rand and Entity.rand. potion: EntityLivingBase.updatePotionEffects for 120 ticks after addPotionEffect(id, MAX_VALUE, amplifier), with the swirls it spawns. player: EntityPlayer.attackEntityFrom up to damageEntity per DamageSource. starve/exhaust: FoodStats.onUpdate with food 0 for 400 ticks, and one exhausted tick at food 10. zombieHit: EntityZombie.attackEntityAsMob with and without fire. zombieSpawn: EntityZombie.onSpawnWithEgg(null) with the reinforcement base set to 0. reinforce: EntityZombie.attackEntityFrom from a spider at 2 blocks, per light level and reinforcement chance.
